question: Should content-verified Android APKs be treated as sendable host-local documents when `tools.fs.workspaceOnly` is false, alongside the existing archive/document categories?
rationale: The implementation can be mechanically repaired, but whether an installable package belongs inside the host-read attachment policy is a durable security/product boundary choice not settled by tests or the prior text-document precedent.

options.title: Accept verified APKs after classifier repairs
options.body: Approve APKs as a host-read category only after the branch preserves prefix-buffer behavior and eliminates extension-only classification.

options.title: Keep the existing document boundary
options.body: Do not add APKs to the host-read allowlist; retain archives and validated documents without treating Android packages as a safe document type.

recommendation.title: Accept verified APKs after classifier repairs
recommendation.body: Approve APKs as a host-read category only after the branch preserves prefix-buffer behavior and eliminates extension-only classification.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature-history evidence places the host-read media policy and its adjacent runtime paths most strongly in this review area.
